description.en: Fills the given array with the camera's current animated-move position/reference data, started with CMND_SET_MOVE_INFO_CAMERA.
Array that receives the current move position/reference data; passed by reference and filled in place.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Read the camera's current move position/reference
CMND_GET_MOVE_INFO_CAMERA(cam_ctrl.hcam, posref);
